AUDITION NOTICE (Community theatre) 

JAB By James McDermott 

Director: Melanie Wray 

Venue: Bob Hope Theatre, Wythfield Road, Eltham, London, SE9 5TG 

Jab is a two hander:    **Anne** 40’s - 50’s NHS worker and **Don** 50’s - 60’s Vintage shop keeper 

The play is set during 2020-2021 and is based on the true story about a breakdown of a long marriage during the Covid pandemic. They fall out over the question/dilemma: should they have the vaccine or not? 

It’s satirical, fast paced, funny, brittle, biting, physical, and savage at times. 

Readthrough:** Sunday 29th November 2026 – 10am – 1pm**       Audition Dates: **Monday 30th November 2026 – 7pm – 10pm         **Extra Audition **Tuesday 1st December 2026 – 7pm – 10pm**

For rehearsal dates and more information  [http://www.bobhopetheatre.co.uk/](http://www.bobhopetheatre.co.uk/)

🎬 CASTING DO SPOTU REKLAMOWEGO
Do ról pierwszoplanowych poszukujemy aktorów/epizodystów:

Kobieta — 18-20 lat

Młoda kobieta o charakterystycznej, naturalnej urodzie i wyrazistej twarzy. Wygląd nastolatki. Długie ciemne włosy, szczupła sylwetka.

Typ: niezależna, współczesna, z charakterem.

Mile widziana naturalna, nieoczywista uroda i mocna osobowość.

Mężczyzna — 65-85 lat

Senior o siwych włosach i zaroście. Szczupła lub średnia sylwetka.

Szukamy osoby ciepłej, wiarygodnej i emocjonalnej, potrafiącej opowiadać historię przede wszystkim spojrzeniem i mimiką.

Naturalność i autentyczność mile widziane.

Mężczyzna — 20-25 lat

Młody, atrakcyjny mężczyzna. Szczupła, proporcjonalna sylwetka.

Typ: miejski, nowoczesny, premium / corporate.

Zadbany, pewny siebie, ambitny.

Zgłoszenia tylko drogą mailową!

📍 Zdjęcia w Warszawie w 2 połowie października 

📩 Zgłoszenia:

blackwolfproductionpl@gmail.com

📝 W treści zgłoszenia podaj:

• Imię i nazwisko

• Wiek

• Numer telefonu

• Zdjęcie twarzy i całej sylwetki

• Demo/real (link do YouTube)

Pozostałe szczegóły przekażemy wybranym osobom.

CASTING CALL: Out, Amongst the Stars

Project Type: Independent feature film

Genre: Sci-fi, Adventure

Tone: Character-driven, dialogue-heavy and incorporating visual effects.

Production Dates: TBC late October-November-December 2026

Location: Leeds and surrounding West Yorkshire area, UK

Pay Rate: Voluntary only. Complimentary copy of the completed film. Cast members can extract their scenes for Showreel purposes from the completed film. Gala screening invite.

Stills, BTS and editorial coverage where possible. The film will be listed on IMDB.

Auditions: To be held in Leeds.

PROJECT SYNOPSIS: 

Forty-six years ago, amid rumours of UFO sightings and government cover-ups, an ordinary family man vanished without a trace. Abi, his now middle-aged daughter, uncovers a truth no one wanted to face – that there was an extraterrestrial visitation, her father's disappearance was no accident, and for reasons still unknown, whatever took him is about to return...

Production scope overview:

Out, Amongst The Stars is the sixth feature film from production company WOTR. This is a microbudget feature film to shoot mainly in Leeds and the surrounding West Yorkshire area.

We are only considering cast who have a base in the region. The main shoot will be approximately 5 weeks, Mondays to Fridays. The completed film will be sent to film festivals and streaming services. The film has a large cast contingent, so other casting notices will follow.

LEAD ROLES:

-Dr. Abi Sherwood (daughter)

Age Range: late 40s to early 50s

Gender: Female

Ethnicity: British White

Character Description: Grounded. Very intelligent, relatable. Science nerd. Dry

sense of humour. Caring. Joyous.

-Usman (scientist, colleague, friend)

Age Range: late 30s to 40s

Gender: Male

Ethnicity: Black Asian

Character Description: GSOH, dependable, smart, witty. Sincere.

-Sergei (scientist)

Age Range: 40s

Gender: Male

Ethnicity: White (Slavic/Russian)

Character Description: Rugged, inquisitive nature, academic, kind

-Evi Sherwood (mother)

Age Range: Late 60s to 70s

Gender: Female

Ethnicity: White

Character Description: Weary, reclusive, academic, drinking issues.

-Adam Sherwood (father)

Age Range: Late 30 to early 40s

Gender: Male

Ethnicity: White

Character Description: Good natured, caring, academic

-Chandraneethan (Theoretical mathematician and Physicist)

Age Range: Late 20s to 30s

Gender: Male

Ethnicity: Indian Asian

Character Description: Confident, gifted Scientist

-Audrey Park (Retired business woman, Wife)

Age Range: Late 50s to 60s

Gender: Female

Ethnicity: Open

Character Description: Stalwart, distraught by events

SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS

Please send the following to [bristylecoaching@outlook.com] with the subject line: [CHARACTER NAME]: [YOUR NAME] - Out, Amogst the Stars Casting Call

-Current Headshot & Resume (PDF format)

-Demo Reel or Video Clip link (Spotlight)

-City/State where you are currently based

I look forward to connecting with You!

With Love & Health,

Bri Miller (Casting Director)

For more information and introductions about our project, please visit: https://www.facebook.com/OutAmongstTheStars
items.previewDescription: Produced by  northern UK based film production company WOTR.

topComments.text:
Unfortunately, I’m not in the UK.  Sounds like a fun shoot. 
I wanted to thank you for explaining that reel footage is not actually provided, but can be extracted from the finished product. My experience has been that almost all independent films promise footage and don’t then provide it. It’s rare to be actually sent reel footage and rare to be told up front that you’ll have to clip it. So, I appreciate the honesty. Wish I could be there.

**SEEKING A BOYS’ CHOIR — SHORT FILM COLLABORATION**

**London | Recording and optional filming**

We’re looking for an **established boys’ choir**, with singers aged **7–12**, based in or around **London**, to collaborate on *Castrato*, a short psychological horror film set in the 1970s.

The story follows a young orphan whose extraordinary singing voice brings him into the care of a celebrated choir director. What initially feels like belonging becomes a disturbing betrayal of trust. The short introduces the world and characters of *Castrato*, with the aim of developing their story into a feature film.

Choral music is central to the story, and the participating choir would make a significant contribution to the film.

**RECORDING**
The choir would record **one song** at **Shoreditch Recording Works**, provisionally in **late November or early December**. The piece, exact date and session timings are still being finalised.

The session would give the choristers an opportunity to experience recording music for film in a professional studio. We would also provide the choir with copies of their studio recordings.

**OPTIONAL ON-SCREEN PARTICIPATION**
We would also welcome a **number of choristers** to appear as the film’s conservatoire choir. Filming is expected to take place in and around London across a few weekends in **January**, with exact dates TBC.

Appearing on screen is optional—the choir can participate in the recording alone. 

**TO EXPRESS INTEREST**
Choir leaders or representatives should email:
* The choir’s name and location
* The singers’ age range and approximate number
* General availability during the proposed recording period

**Email:** [castratofilm@gmail.com](mailto:castratofilm@gmail.com)
**Subject:** CHOIR CASTING — [CHOIR NAME]

We would be happy to arrange a call to discuss the project further.

Please feel free to share with any choirs or choir leaders who may be interested!

items.text:
**CASTING CALL — TWO ADULT LEAD ROLES**

**Paid roles | London | January filming**

We’re casting **Father John and Michel-César** for *Castrato*, a short psychological horror film set in the 1970s.

The story follows a young orphan whose extraordinary singing voice brings him into the care of a celebrated choir director. What initially feels like belonging becomes a disturbing betrayal of trust. The short introduces the world and characters of *Castrato*, with the aim of developing their story into a feature film.

**FATHER JOHN — Male, playing age 50s**
A strangely attractive priest who runs the boys’ orphanage. Charming yet immediately unsettling, Father John has peculiar habits, nervous twitches and a menacing presence even when smiling. We’re looking for an actor who can embrace his strangeness without becoming cartoonish, creating discomfort through small gestures and changes in expression.

**MICHEL-CÉSAR — Male, playing age 60s**
A prestigious French choir director with a warm, almost grandfatherly presence. Meticulous about order and devoted to his choir, Michel initially feels kind and trustworthy. Gradually, subtle shifts reveal something darker beneath that warmth. We need an actor whose performance allows the unease to creep up on the audience rather than being obvious from the start.

Applicants should be based in or around **London**. Filming is expected to take place across a few weekends in **January**, with exact dates TBC. Both roles are **paid**, with rates TBC.

**TO APPLY**
Actors or agents should email:
* A headshot
* Age and location
* A CV and/or showreel link

**Email:** [castratofilm@gmail.com](mailto:castratofilm@gmail.com)
**Subject:** CASTRATO CASTING — [ROLE]

Selected applicants will receive audition material and self-tape instructions.

**Content note:** The film contains sensitive themes and violence, with no nudity or explicit surgical content. Please get in touch with any questions about the material.

Please feel free to share with anyone who may be suitable!

Hallo zusammen,
ich suche nach neuen Einstiegsmöglichkeiten, Projekten oder Open Calls im Bereich **physisches Theater, Live-Performance, moderne Kunstaktionen** und freie/queere Szene als **textilfreier Performer**, Darsteller oder Komparse.

**Kurz zu mir:** Ich bringe außergewöhnlichen Mut für textilfreie Kunst sowie Extreme Body Art mit. Über zwei Jahrzehnte war ich regelmäßiger Teil einer der bekanntesten queeren Partyreihen Deutschlands („Irrenhouse“ in Berlin) und besitze umfassende Erfahrung mit durchgehenden, interaktiven Performances. Auch als erfahrenes Textilfreies Modell (vor allem für dynamische Posen/Wechselposen) stehe ich gerne zur Verfügung.

Da viele Castings in der freien Szene intern laufen, suche ich hier den direkten Weg zu Regisseuren, Choreografen und Kollektiven für Projekte im Raum Leipzig, Mitteldeutschland und Berlin.
* **Mein detailliertes Künstler-Portfolio** mit allen bisherigen Stationen und Interessen **ist direkt auf meinem Facebook-Profil verlinkt**! Schreibt mir bei Interesse auch gerne direkt eine private Nachricht (PN).

Habt ihr Tipps für aktuelle Projekte, Netzwerke oder konkrete Open Calls, bei denen Performer mit Körpererfahrung gesucht werden? Ich freue mich über jede Nachricht oder Empfehlung!

**SEEKING A BOYS’ CHOIR — SHORT FILM COLLABORATION**

**London | Recording and optional filming**

We’re looking for an **established boys’ choir**, with singers aged **7–12**, based in or around **London**, to collaborate on *Castrato*, a short psychological horror film set in the 1970s.

The story follows a young orphan whose extraordinary singing voice brings him into the care of a celebrated choir director. What initially feels like belonging becomes a disturbing betrayal of trust. The short introduces the world and characters of *Castrato*, with the aim of developing their story into a feature film.

Choral music is central to the story, and the participating choir would make a significant contribution to the film.

**RECORDING**
The choir would record **one song** at **Shoreditch Recording Works**, provisionally in **late November or early December**. The piece, exact date and session timings are still being finalised.

The session would give the choristers an opportunity to experience recording music for film in a professional studio. We would also provide the choir with copies of their studio recordings.

**OPTIONAL ON-SCREEN PARTICIPATION**
We would also welcome a **number of choristers** to appear as the film’s conservatoire choir. Filming is expected to take place in and around London across a few weekends in **January**, with exact dates TBC.

Appearing on screen is optional—the choir can participate in the recording alone. 

**TO EXPRESS INTEREST**
Choir leaders or representatives should email:
* The choir’s name and location
* The singers’ age range and approximate number
* General availability during the proposed recording period

**Email:** [castratofilm@gmail.com](mailto:castratofilm@gmail.com)
**Subject:** CHOIR CASTING — [CHOIR NAME]

We would be happy to arrange a call to discuss the project further.

Please feel free to share with any choirs or choir leaders who may be interested!

items.text:
Hello! 

We are casting for another tourism video filmed out in Kamloops. We are looking for an adventurous couple, approximately 45–60 years old, who have a natural ease, playfulness and convincing chemistry together. We would love to see a couple that can spark off each other, and are able to tease each other in a light hearted way, without taking themselves seriously. 

We’re looking for people who feel:

* Warm, curious, and naturally engaging

* Ready for adventure and enjoy an active lifestyle

* Curious about travel and the people they meet

* Comfortable hiking recreationally

* Relaxed and natural on camera

* One member of the couple must be comfortable driving with a full drivers license 

* Will need a standard American accent

The short video follows a couple through a series of experiences - hiking, biking, wineries, and restaurants. The idea is to showcase that this region has something to offer for everyone; both the adventure seekers and the chill outers. The couple will be reading reviews of the spots as they go along, and find themselves getting curious about what they might discover. 

Details:
- 3 days w/c 19th October
- Day rate range $700-$1000 depending on experience
- Kamloops area, must be able to drive to location

If interested, please complete below submission and email georgia@weareskeletoncrew.ca

**SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS **

For this project, the client is looking for a couple submission only. 

We would love to see you both in frame, side by side, framed from the top of the head to just above chest. 

Please submit:
* Slate
* Scene 1
* Scene 2

**On your slate we would love to see:**
* Name, height, location, union status

**Scene 1**

Describe your last adventure weekend. Where would you go, what activities would you do? What roles did you both play on the trip? Does one of you do the planning, how do you compromise? 

**Scene 2**

Find an online review for any location, coffee shop, restaurant, and read it allowed to your partner. Discuss between you what you think it’ll be like, and you decide to give it a go!

**Casting:** 3 look alikes for an Investigating Discovery True Crime Docu-Series

Non-Union

Rate: $250/day

Location: Los Angeles, CA

Shoot date: 10/27-10/28

This will be a recreation shoot with no dialogue. Actors will be required to sign an NDA prior to arriving on set.

***To Submit:***

***Email headshot and resume to kwall@altrealitytv.com***

Please do not DM. TIA!

Roles:

[JONATHAN]

Man; 40 to 65 years old;

Casting look alike for an early-mid 50's caucasian male:

Short, clean-cut gray/silver hair Clean-shaven

5'11-6'3

Slender/Lean/Slim-Athletic Build

[DETECTIVE BLOOM]

Man; 30 to 50 years old; White.

Casting Look alike for a 40yo caucasian male:

Short, crew cut-style blonde/gray/light brown hair

Clean-shaven

5'8-6'1

Medium Build- can be athletic or stocky

Please note if you have a police-style uniform.

Woman; 23 to 40 years old; Casting Look alike for an early 30s female, ethnically ambiguous but fair, light, or olive skin (need to match a real person)

Dark, straight, shiny hair shoulder length or a few inches longer

5'7-6'0

Slim build

No visible tattoos or piercings that cannot be covered. Ear piercings are okay.

We’re looking for a Sound Operator, Editor, 1st/2nd AC, and Hair and Make-Up Artist to join our team for the 48-Hour Film Project, taking place October 16–18!

Volunteer/Unpaid (as per rules)

Meal provided

Location: Downtown Toronto 

**Sound Operator **

Shoot day: Saturday, October 17

Tentative shoot time: 9:00 AM–10:00 PM

**HMUA**

Shoot day: Saturday, October 17

Tentative shoot time: 9:00 AM–10:00 PM

**Editor: **Editing will take place between October 17–18, with availability throughout the weekend needed to meet the submission deadline.

This is an opportunity to collaborate with fellow creatives and bring an original short film to life in just 48 hours.

Interested? Please send me an email to [thestarplayersto@gmail.com](mailto:thestarplayersto@gmail.com) with a little about your experience and any relevant portfolio or work samples.

Feel free to share with anyone who might be interested!

Let’s make something great!

**CASTING CALL — TWO CHILD LEAD ROLES**

**Paid roles | London | January filming**

We’re casting **Peter and Albert** for *Castrato*, a short psychological horror film set in the 1970s.

The story follows a young orphan whose extraordinary singing voice brings him into the care of a celebrated choir director. What initially feels like belonging becomes a disturbing betrayal of trust. The short introduces the world and characters of *Castrato*, with the aim of developing their story into a feature film.

**PETER — Male, playing age 7–11**
An incredibly sweet, innocent and shy boy with an almost angelic appearance and expressive eyes. Timid and withdrawn following the loss of his parents, Peter has little dialogue. We’re looking for a young performer who can convey vulnerability through subtle expressions and reactions. Previous acting experience and confidence taking direction would be helpful.

**ALBERT — Male, playing age 10–11**
Boisterous, cocky and outwardly confident, Albert enjoys intimidating the other boys and feels threatened when Peter becomes the favourite. Beneath his bravado is a deeply insecure child. We need a performer who can move from arrogance and jealousy to the frightened, vulnerable boy underneath.

**Singing ability is required for both roles.**

Applicants should be based in or around **London**. Filming is expected to take place across a few weekends in **January**, with exact dates TBC. Both roles are **paid**, with rates TBC.

**TO APPLY**
Parents, guardians or agents should email:
* A headshot
* The actor’s age and location
* Details of acting and singing experience

**Email:** [castratofilm@gmail.com](mailto:castratofilm@gmail.com)
**Subject:** CASTRATO CASTING — [ROLE]

Selected applicants will receive audition material and self-tape instructions.

**Content note:** The film contains sensitive themes and violence, with no nudity or explicit surgical content. Please get in touch with any questions about the material.

Please feel free to share with anyone who may be suitable!

**CASTING CALL:** "Rave Hard, Recover Fast", a narrative **SPEC** commercial for Happy Tuesdays (London)

We're PickledFish, an Edinburgh based narrative production company. We're casting two leads for a stylised, Matrix-inspired narrative spec commercial for UK post-rave recovery brand Happy Tuesdays. It's a fully practical production, we'll shoot on the Alexa Mini LF in a professional London studio, with a full professional crew.

See our work: https://pickledfish.tv

After a big night out, Leo collapses on his couch and wakes in an endless white room. A mysterious suited figure offers him a choice: painkillers and a wasted day, or something better.

📅** Shoot: 14–15 Nov, London**

—

**LEO** (lead, male, playing age 21–35, 2 shoot days)

Leo is a committed raver: still dancing when he's running on empty, then waking up bright, sharp and himself again. The role has no dialogue, so it's all physicality and expression. It goes from exhausted and spaced-out, to confused and wide-eyed in the white room, to warm, easy and laughing the next morning.

We're looking for someone who:
* is comfortable dancing on camera
* can tell a story with their body and face, without lines
* is available both days

—

**SUITED FIGURE **(lead, any gender, any ethnicity, playing age 30–65, 1 shoot day)

The Suited Figure is a calm, commanding and slightly unnerving guide who exists in "the moment just before you fall asleep." Think of a hypnotic mentor figure: measured, precise, a little theatrical, with total control of the room. They wear a dark suit, green tie and rimless glasses, which we provide. A homage to a certain iconic character.

We're looking for someone with:
* a strong voice and mesmerising delivery, since this role carries all of the film's dialogue
* stillness and presence on screen
* availability for one day, within 14–15 Nov (we'll confirm the date once you're cast)

—

💷 **Unpaid.** Food and travel are provided along with an IMDb-style credit, and a high-quality copy of the finished film for your reel.

Usage: this is a spec commercial. It'll be presented to the brand, and used on PickledFish's portfolio, online channels and in festival submissions.

—

🎥 HOW TO APPLY

Email your self-tape link, headshot and CV to hello@pickledfish.tv with the role name in the subject line, by Sun 25 Oct. Applications by email only, please. We can't take submissions via DM or comments.

**LEO:** walk to a chair, slump into it exhausted and fall asleep. Then wake up, open your hand, and smile at what you find. A 10–20 second dance clip is a bonus.

**SUITED FIGURE: **record a self-tape of these sides:
"This... is the moment just before you fall asleep. You have a choice to make. Maybe your head hurts a little bit less, but you still wake up sluggish and dazed, stuck in bed as the day marches on. Remember, the choice is yours, yours, yours, yours, yours, yours..."

**Tworzymy czułą przestrzeń twórczą, dla Twojego dziecka, na Mokotowie!**

**Mała Akademia Teatralna **Czuła Fundacja Centrum Twórcze Przestrzenie wystartowała!

Są jeszcze ostatnie miejsca w obydwu grupach!

Podaruj swojemu dziecku bezpieczną przestrzeń do rozwoju, profesjonalnej edukacji teatralnej i eksploracji wyobraźni!

Spotykamy się we wtorki.

Z dziećmi od 7 do 9 lat - od 16.00 do 17.30.

Z dziećmi od 9 do 12 lat od 17.30 do 19.00.

w FORMA Ośrodek Kultury

Zajęcia Małej Akademii Teatralnej to profesjonalna edukacja teatralna, w poszanowaniu granic uczestników. Na moich zajęciach dzieci się wygłupiają i szaleją. Mogą zrealizować wszystkie swoje pomysły. Twarzą pełne wsparcia relacje rówieśnicze.

Pamiętam, czego mi brakowało, kiedy jako dziecko uczyłam się teatru. I właśnie to - daję teraz dzieciom.

Jeśli chcesz dowiedzieć się więcej o naszych warsztatach artystycznych i twórczej działalności, odwiedź naszą stronę internetową: https://www.czulafundacja.pl/tworcze-przestrzenie

albo stronę FB Centrum Twórcze Przestrzenie.

Możesz też do nas napisać na adres: czulafundacja@czulafundacja.pl

Any filmmakers in Warsaw looking to show their work to a live audience?

I’m Miguel from Impact Warsaw. We’re developing a film evening where independent filmmakers can screen their work, meet the audience and have a conversation afterwards.

I’d love to hear from Polish and international filmmakers with a short film, documentary or independent feature they’d like to present.

Send me a message or email hello@impactwarsaw.com with:

• A short description of your film
• Running time, language and available subtitles
• A trailer or private viewing link
• Whether you could attend a screening in Warsaw

We’ll discuss dates, screening permissions and practical arrangements directly with the filmmakers.

Would love to see what you’ve been working on.

Any filmmakers in Warsaw looking to show their work to a live audience?
🇵🇱⬇️

I’m Miguel from Impact Warsaw. We’re developing a film evening where independent filmmakers can screen their work, meet the audience and have a conversation afterwards.

I’d love to hear from Polish and international filmmakers with a short film, documentary or independent feature they’d like to present.

Send me a message or email hello@impactwarsaw.com with:

• A short description of your film
• Running time, language and available subtitles
• A trailer or private viewing link
• Whether you could attend a screening in Warsaw

We’ll discuss dates, screening permissions and practical arrangements directly with the filmmakers.

Would love to see what you’ve been working on.

Są tu filmowcy, którzy chcieliby pokazać swoją twórczość publiczności w Warszawie?

Mam na imię Miguel i tworzę Impact Warsaw. Przygotowujemy pomysł na wieczór filmowy, podczas którego niezależni twórcy będą mogli zaprezentować swoje filmy, spotkać się z widzami i porozmawiać po seansie.

Chętnie poznam polskich i zagranicznych filmowców, którzy chcieliby pokazać swój krótki metraż, dokument lub niezależny film pełnometrażowy.

Napisz do mnie prywatnie lub na hello@impactwarsaw.com i prześlij:

• Krótki opis filmu
• Czas trwania, język i informację o dostępnych napisach
• Zwiastun lub prywatny link do obejrzenia filmu
• Informację, czy możesz osobiście uczestniczyć w pokazie w Warszawie

Termin, zgodę na pokaz i szczegóły organizacyjne ustalimy bezpośrednio z twórcami.

Chętnie zobaczę, nad czym pracujecie.

items.text: Hi my daughter age 14 has been in acting classes for a few years now and wants to cast, where’s the best place to start or look please?

topComments.text:
You can join sites like Mandy and keep an eye out for open castings for lower budget Indie films etc but be vigilant, do your due diligence and ensure it is properly licensed.
The vast majority of professional work is cast via Spotlight for which she needs an agent. Unfortunately age 14 is pretty much the worst age to try to start and it may be better to wait until after GCSES and things pick up a little, agencies may be more receptive etc... right now unless she is tiny and looks young so could pass for age 11 there are very few opportunities indeed especially without previous experience and agencies already have their books full of teens who have been doing it for years all chasing very few opportunities... It costs at least £300 per year to have Spotlight and Headshots before any other costs... It is also generally very quiet in the industry... My 14 year old has lots of experience but auditions are more and more rare.

It's a really tough age as a teen coupled with it being really quiet at the moment.  Can check out open castings on instagram or sites like Mandy but finding an agent gives best chance.  Needs to be looking as young as possible

Hey everyone! We’re a team of LA-based indie filmmakers that are part of a community bringing together people working in movies across Los Angeles. Just good people, great conversations, and real connections. We welcome people at every level of their career.

Our mission is simple: Help each other make movies, connect, and network.

We meet in Boyle Heights every 1st Thursday of the month at 6pm.

Whether you're an actor, filmmaker, writer, producer, director, DOP, or working behind the scenes, we'd love for you to join us!

Entrance is FREE, but RSVP is required as space is limited.

**RSVP here:** https://partiful.com/e/lY9sDO0ZosP3nr2bcNVl?c=Y6ysr1LC

Hope to see some of you there! Feel free to share this with anyone in the LA film and TV community.

Drinks and snacks available for purchase.

**🎬 CASTING CALL **🎥

**FEATURE FILM CAST DESCRIPTION**

**TERROR IN TIMMONTON**

**An Independent Mystery / Suspense Feature Film**

**Production Company:** R&R Visionary Productions
**Genre:** Mystery / Suspense
**Production Type:** Independent Feature Film
**Union Status:** Non-Union
**Filming Location:** Waterloo / Cedar Falls, Iowa
**Filming Begins:** Summer 2027
**Projected Release:** 2028
**Casting Deadline:** October 31, 2026

**About the Film**

*She survived the nightmare. But what if leaving it behind only led her into another?*

After enduring more than eight years of abuse, Hailee finally escapes her troubled past, only to become the victim of a brutal attack that nearly takes her life.

While recovering in the hospital, she develops an unexpected friendship with a male nurse who offers her the opportunity to leave Arizona and begin a new life.

But her fresh start takes a mysterious turn when she discovers a hidden note behind a bedroom nightstand.

**"If you are reading this, that means I am dead. — Annalise."**

Determined to uncover the truth, Hailee begins asking questions about Annalise. However, the people around her claim to know nothing about the mysterious woman.

As secrets begin to surface, Hailee realizes that her new home may hold a disturbing past—and that some people will do anything to keep the truth buried.

**Compensation and Meals**

This is an **unpaid, volunteer-based independent feature film production**. There is no monetary compensation for acting roles.

Participants will have the opportunity to gain valuable on-set experience, develop their acting skills, build their portfolios, and participate in a full-length feature film.

**Lunch and supper will be provided at no cost to cast members on their scheduled filming days.**

**How to Apply**

Interested actors may submit through **Backstage** or email:

**[rrvisionaryproductions@gmail.com](mailto:rrvisionaryproductions@gmail.com)**

Please include:
* Your full name and contact information
* The character or role you wish to audition for
* A recent headshot or photograph
* Acting résumé or previous experience, if available
* Your anticipated availability during Summer 2027

**CASTING DEADLINE: OCTOBER 31, 2026**

**JOIN THE CAST!**

R&R Visionary Productions welcomes dedicated, enthusiastic individuals who are passionate about storytelling and independent filmmaking.

Help us bring the secrets, mystery, and suspense of *Terror in *

*Timmonton* to the big screen!

**R&R Visionary Productions**
*Bringing Stories to Life*

***On recherche un comédien en vue du rôle principal masculin, 20-25 ans, pour un clip musical étudiant à Angers (Pays de la Loire, France)***
# 
**Le projet** : 

Clip musical appelé « Ok Ok Ok » du groupe "Fleuri Désert"
# 
**Cadre **: 

Projet pédagogique d'étudiants en Bachelor Réalisateur Monteur de l'école Studio M Angers.
# 
**Date du tournage **: 

Samedi 24 octobre 2026, journée et soirée, à Angers 
# 
⚠️ ***non défrayé*** ⚠️

**LE RÔLE **

Rôle principal, muet. Un jeune homme dont la vie lui échappe : il rate un rendez-vous avec une fille, puis un rendez-vous avec un employeur, et chaque échec l'enfonce un peu plus. Il en souffre, et ça doit se voir.
Le personnage met en images les paroles de la chanson. Tout passe par le visage, le corps et les réactions. Le ton est très théâtrale, presque exagéré par moment tout en étant capable de transmettre des émotions forte à d'autre moment. On cherche donc idéalement quelqu'un capable de jouer un personnage désemparé et d'aller loin dans l'expression sans que ça sonne faux.
Pas de danse
# 
PROFIL 

Homme, 20 à 25 ans.
À l'aise avec le jeu expressif et physique. Une expérience en théâtre, impro ou tournage est un plus.
# 
INFOS PRATIQUES

Il faut être disponible toute la journée et la soirée du samedi 24 octobre, à Angers (49).

# CANDIDATURE 

Par mail à [goldenlight.rh@gmail.com](mailto:goldenlight.rh@gmail.com?subject=Votre%20annonce%20dans%20cineaste.org%20#3628)
***Objet obligatoire : Casting Clip musical*** (car on recherche pour plusieurs projets en ce moment)
Joindre : une photo récente (visage et plein pied), votre âge, votre ville, et si possible un lien vers une vidéo de jeu.
Date limite : 14 octobre 2026

Clap&Light Productions ([goldenlight.rh@gmail.com](mailto:goldenlight.rh@gmail.com?subject=Votre%20annonce%20dans%20cineaste.org%20#3628))

**CASTING CALL — TWO CHILD LEAD ROLES**

**Paid roles | London | January filming**

We’re casting **Peter and Albert** for *Castrato*, a short psychological horror film set in the 1970s.

The story follows a young orphan whose extraordinary singing voice brings him into the care of a celebrated choir director. What initially feels like belonging becomes a disturbing betrayal of trust. The short introduces the world and characters of *Castrato*, with the aim of developing their story into a feature film.

**PETER — Male, playing age 7–11**
An incredibly sweet, innocent and shy boy with an almost angelic appearance and expressive eyes. Timid and withdrawn following the loss of his parents, Peter has little dialogue. We’re looking for a young performer who can convey vulnerability through subtle expressions and reactions. Previous acting experience and confidence taking direction would be helpful.

**ALBERT — Male, playing age 10–11**
Boisterous, cocky and outwardly confident, Albert enjoys intimidating the other boys and feels threatened when Peter becomes the favourite. Beneath his bravado is a deeply insecure child. We need a performer who can move from arrogance and jealousy to the frightened, vulnerable boy underneath.

**Singing ability is required for both roles.**

Applicants should be based in or around **London**. Filming is expected to take place across a few weekends in **January**, with exact dates TBC. Both roles are **paid**, with rates TBC.

**TO APPLY**
Parents, guardians or agents should email:
* A headshot
* The actor’s age and location
* Details of acting and singing experience

**Email:** [castratofilm@gmail.com](mailto:castratofilm@gmail.com)
**Subject:** CASTRATO CASTING — [ROLE]

Selected applicants will receive audition material and self-tape instructions.

**Content note:** The film contains sensitive themes and violence, with no nudity or explicit surgical content. Please get in touch with any questions about the material.

Please feel free to share with anyone who may be suitable!

**CASTING! SZUKAMY AKTORÓW DO NOWEJ KOMEDII TEATRALNEJ!**

Pracujemy nad nowym spektaklem komediowym o młodym małżeństwie, codziennych absurdach życia we dwoje i problemach, które ciężko rozwiązać.

Poszukujemy charyzmatycznych aktorów z doskonałym wyczuciem komedii (nie musisz być profesjonalistą):
EWA (22-27 lat) - temperamentna, inteligentna, błyskotliwa. Kobieta z charakterem, ciętym językiem i doskonałym wyczuciem ironii.

ADAM (25–30 lat) - sympatyczny, sarkastyczny, nieco nieporadny życiowo. Mistrz wymówek i pakowania się w kłopoty. Najlepiej z lekkim brzuszkiem

KRZYSIEK (25–30 lat) - najlepszy kumpel Adama. Wygadany, pewny siebie, z talentem do pakowania innych w tarapaty.

Szukamy osób z dobrą energią sceniczną, świetnym timingiem komediowym, naturalnością w dialogach i swobodą w kontakcie z publicznością. Mile widziane doświadczenie w komedii, farsie oraz improwizacji.

JAK SIĘ ZGŁOSIĆ?

Prześlij zdjęcie, krótką informację o sobie, doświadczenie aktorskie oraz wizytówkę (jeśli posiadasz) na adres: biuro@enemka.pl lub zgłoś się pod postem

Miejsce prób: Czechowice-Dziedzice/Bielsko-Biała

Termin realizacji: próby grudzień/styczeń; spektakle od stycznia do maja 2027
Wynagrodzenie: do ustalenia

Zgłoś się, może właśnie Ciebie zobaczymy na scenie!

**SEEKING A BOYS’ CHOIR — SHORT FILM COLLABORATION**

**London | Recording and optional filming**

We’re looking for an **established boys’ choir**, with singers aged **7–12**, based in or around **London**, to collaborate on *Castrato*, a short psychological horror film set in the 1970s.

The story follows a young orphan whose extraordinary singing voice brings him into the care of a celebrated choir director. What initially feels like belonging becomes a disturbing betrayal of trust. The short introduces the world and characters of *Castrato*, with the aim of developing their story into a feature film.

Choral music is central to the story, and the participating choir would make a significant contribution to the film.

**RECORDING**
The choir would record **one song** at **Shoreditch Recording Works**, provisionally in **late November or early December**. The piece, exact date and session timings are still being finalised.

The session would give the choristers an opportunity to experience recording music for film in a professional studio. We would also provide the choir with copies of their studio recordings.

**OPTIONAL ON-SCREEN PARTICIPATION**
We would also welcome a **number of choristers** to appear as the film’s conservatoire choir. Filming is expected to take place in and around London across a few weekends in **January**, with exact dates TBC.

Appearing on screen is optional—the choir can participate in the recording alone. 

**TO EXPRESS INTEREST**
Choir leaders or representatives should email:
* The choir’s name and location
* The singers’ age range and approximate number
* General availability during the proposed recording period

**Email:** [castratofilm@gmail.com](mailto:castratofilm@gmail.com)
**Subject:** CHOIR CASTING — [CHOIR NAME]

We would be happy to arrange a call to discuss the project further.

Please feel free to share with any choirs or choir leaders who may be interested!

**CASTING CALL — TWO ADULT LEAD ROLES**

**Paid roles | London | January filming**

We’re casting **Father John and Michel-César** for *Castrato*, a short psychological horror film set in the 1970s.

The story follows a young orphan whose extraordinary singing voice brings him into the care of a celebrated choir director. What initially feels like belonging becomes a disturbing betrayal of trust. The short introduces the world and characters of *Castrato*, with the aim of developing their story into a feature film.

**FATHER JOHN — Male, playing age 50s**
A strangely attractive priest who runs the boys’ orphanage. Charming yet immediately unsettling, Father John has peculiar habits, nervous twitches and a menacing presence even when smiling. We’re looking for an actor who can embrace his strangeness without becoming cartoonish, creating discomfort through small gestures and changes in expression.

**MICHEL-CÉSAR — Male, playing age 60s**
A prestigious French choir director with a warm, almost grandfatherly presence. Meticulous about order and devoted to his choir, Michel initially feels kind and trustworthy. Gradually, subtle shifts reveal something darker beneath that warmth. We need an actor whose performance allows the unease to creep up on the audience rather than being obvious from the start.

Applicants should be based in or around **London**. Filming is expected to take place across a few weekends in **January**, with exact dates TBC. Both roles are **paid**, with rates TBC.

**TO APPLY**
Actors or agents should email:
* A headshot
* Age and location
* A CV and/or showreel link

**Email:** [castratofilm@gmail.com](mailto:castratofilm@gmail.com)
**Subject:** CASTRATO CASTING — [ROLE]

Selected applicants will receive audition material and self-tape instructions.

**Content note:** The film contains sensitive themes and violence, with no nudity or explicit surgical content. Please get in touch with any questions about the material.

Please feel free to share with anyone who may be suitable!

**CASTING CALL — TWO CHILD LEAD ROLES**

**Paid roles | London | January filming**

We’re casting **Peter and Albert** for *Castrato*, a short psychological horror film set in the 1970s.

The story follows a young orphan whose extraordinary singing voice brings him into the care of a celebrated choir director. What initially feels like belonging becomes a disturbing betrayal of trust. The short introduces the world and characters of *Castrato*, with the aim of developing their story into a feature film.

**PETER — Male, playing age 7–11**
An incredibly sweet, innocent and shy boy with an almost angelic appearance and expressive eyes. Timid and withdrawn following the loss of his parents, Peter has little dialogue. We’re looking for a young performer who can convey vulnerability through subtle expressions and reactions. Previous acting experience and confidence taking direction would be helpful.

**ALBERT — Male, playing age 10–11**
Boisterous, cocky and outwardly confident, Albert enjoys intimidating the other boys and feels threatened when Peter becomes the favourite. Beneath his bravado is a deeply insecure child. We need a performer who can move from arrogance and jealousy to the frightened, vulnerable boy underneath.

**Singing ability is required for both roles.**

Applicants should be based in or around **London**. Filming is expected to take place across a few weekends in **January**, with exact dates TBC. Both roles are **paid**, with rates TBC.

**TO APPLY**
Parents, guardians or agents should email:
* A headshot
* The actor’s age and location
* Details of acting and singing experience

**Email:** [castratofilm@gmail.com](mailto:castratofilm@gmail.com)

Selected applicants will receive audition material and self-tape instructions.

Mezinárodní filmový festival BRNO16 se řadí mezi nejdéle fungující filmové festivaly v České republice. Od svého založení v roce 1960 se koná nepřetržitě a zároveň patří k nejstarším přehlídkám krátkometrážní tvorby na světě. Představuje široké spektrum krátkých filmů, od hraných a animovaných až po experimentální snímky, a to jak od studentů, tak od profesionálních i neprofesionálních tvůrců. Vedle prestižní filmové soutěže nabízí také bohatý doprovodný program zahrnující výstavy, diskuse a workshopy. Festival každoročně hostí řadu českých i zahraničních osobností, které návštěvníkům umožňují nahlédnout do zákulisí své tvorby a diskutovat o filmech i zkušenostech z filmového prostředí.
___
Plánujete dorazit? 🎬
___
#kinoboxcz #kinobox #pozvánka #festival #brno16

Five friends sit around a campfire when one asks a question: how would you want to die? By the end of the night, you realise why they’re really out there.

**Looking for:**
* **MAREK** (M, 30s, Polish Accent) the loud, warm showman

* **AMA** (F, 30s, Ghanaian Accent) no patience, very funny in silence

* **ARJUN** (M, late 20s, Indian Accent) the relentless optimist

🎬 **CASTING: WAY TO GO (short film, dark comedy)**

Five friends sit around a campfire when one asks a question: how would you want to die? By the end of the night, you realise why they’re really out there.

**Looking for:**
* **MAREK** (M, 30s, Polish Accent) the loud, warm showman
* **FREDRIC** (M, late 20s, White, RP/London) dry, literal, over-explains
* **AMA** (F, 30s, Ghanaian Accent) no patience, very funny in silence
* **SOPHIE** (F, 20s, White, northern accent a plus) bone-dry deadpan
* **ARJUN** (M, late 20s, Indian Accent) the relentless optimist

📍 London · 📅 One night, first week of Nov · 💷 travel and meals

To apply, email us at cinestakes@gmail.com with your headshot, reel and role. Deadline 17th October 2026.

Please share 🙏

#castingcall #londonactors #shortfilm

🎤 12-WEEK BEGINNER SINGING COURSE- FREE TRIAL! ONLINE 🎤

Always wanted to learn to sing but not sure where to start? 

I’m running a small 3-month online beginner singing course for adults— perfect if you’d love to develop your voice, build confidence and understand how to sing with better technique, all from the comfort of your own home. 

Over 12 weekly sessions, we’ll work on: 

Breathing & posture
Pitch & vocal technique
Range & resonance
Registers & rhythm
Articulation & phrasing
Musical expression & confidence 

The sessions are friendly, supportive and completely beginner-friendly. No previous singing experience is needed. 

👥 Small group 

📅 FREE TRIAL SESSION: 22nd October
🕗 8:00pm
💻 Online 

The course is about developing your voice and confidence rather than auditions or performance -so whether you’re a complete beginner or you’ve always wanted to sing but never known where to start, you’re very welcome. 

✨ FREE trial session - 22nd October at 8pm 

To secure your place at the free trial, fill in the form below: 

https://form.jotform.com/260913782349364 

Spaces are limited, so get in touch if you’d like to join! 🎶 

www.vocalizestudio.co.uk

CASTING CALL | MALE TALENT — RAZOR CAMPAIGN

A.L.T. is sourcing South African male talent aged 30–35 for an upcoming razor campaign. All races are welcome.

PROJECT DETAILS

* Industry: Razor campaign
* Talent: South African males, ages 30–35
* Rate: R2,400 net
* Physical shoot: Not required
* Submission deadline: Friday, 16 October

Selected talent will submit photographs and videos according to specific guidelines. Still images will be used to generate AI video content.

TO APPLY, WHATSAPP +27 76 180 2729 WITH:

1. Full name, age, nationality and height
2. 10 recent photographs
3. A casting video introducing yourself, including your name, age, height and hobbies. Turn to show both side profiles and show your hands clearly.

PHOTO REQUIREMENTS

* No group photos or mirror selfies
* No hats or glasses
* No filters or AI-generated images

Shortlisted candidates will be contacted once the client confirms the final selection.

SUBMISSIONS CLOSE FRIDAY 16TH

**Casting Call: 3 Actors for Security-Awareness Videos | Berlin**

We're looking for three Berlin-based actors for a series of 21 short security-awareness training videos for a large cybersecurity company.

**Who we're looking for:**
* Fluent English with a neutral American accent.
* A professional, approachable presence. Open to different ages and backgrounds.
* Natural, expressive delivery with personality - comfortable bringing curiosity, concern, surprise and urgency to educational content.
* We're aiming for a diverse cast, ideally two women and one man.

**Shoot details:**
* One full shoot day in Berlin, date TBC.
* Each actor will present several videos within the series.
* Paid project. Fee and usage terms to be agreed before booking.
* Content will be used for corporate security-awareness training and dubbed into approximately 40 languages.

To apply, please send your headshots, showreel or an English-language performance sample, availability in October, and your day rate. Shortlisted actors will be invited to submit a brief self-tape.

**Contact:** alena@representstudio.com or telegram @xvostikova

items.text:
Jigsaw Casting is seeking Canadian User -generated videos that show a ‘winning moment’ in life for a LOTTO 649 campaign done through TBWA\Canada (address: 219 Dufferin Street, Suite 302C, Toronto, ON, M6K 3J1/Tel: 416.483.3600/https://tbwa.ca/

We are looking for those moments that feel like someone is coming out on top. Your video clips should have a range of emotions. Some are fist pumping celebrations (i.e. catching a baseball). Others are beautiful, heartfelt moments (i.e. someone asking out his crush and getting her number, or someone getting married and it was a very emotional romantic moment).

We’ll prioritize a broad range of Canadian experiences and affinities, from fishing and outdoor activities to sports, city moments, friendships, family and romantic relationships.

Canadian-shot content only: All footage must be filmed in Canada. Canadian creators are preferred, and recognizable non-Canadian locations/backdrops should be avoided. Generic footage from a Canadian creator that does not reveal an identifiable foreign location may be considered subject to client approval.

What we are looking for:

Our clips also fall into two camps: The Win and The Agency.

The Win
This shows the moment people come out on top.
For example:
→ Pulling a giant trout from the water
→ Catching a home run baseball in the stands

The Agency
This shows a moment of doubt, hesitation, or choice.
→ A moment before their hole-in-one swing, a friend saying they can’t make the shot.
→ Someone getting egged on before they go on stage and slay at karaoke.
→ Someone is deliberating doing that cliff dive. Do they vs don’t they.

If you have another footage that is a wild card, it may not fit the above specs, you can still submit it.

🎬 **CASTING CALL – A MISTAKE (Short Film)**

Hi everyone! We're looking for two actors for our upcoming **7-minute short film**, *A Mistake*, shooting in Central Burnaby on **October 29**.

**LOGLINE**
Two friends bond over the struggles of dating and being single while on a hike, but things take an awkward turn when one jokingly suggests they start dating each other and the other doesn't take it well.

**ROLES**

**BEN | Late 20s | Open ethnicity**
A bit awkward, literal, and straightforward, with a dry sense of humour. Ben and Sarah were friends in high school but drifted apart after graduation. He's been single for a while and figures he has nothing to lose by jokingly suggesting they start dating, but the conversation takes an unexpected turn.

**SARAH | Late 20s | Open ethnicity**
Outgoing and sociable, Sarah works as a schoolteacher and has an easy warmth about her. She's been single for a while and struggles to process or identify what she's feeling, particularly when it comes to relationships. She and Ben were friends in high school but drifted apart before reconnecting after college. The hike serves as a chance for them to catch up.

**PRODUCTION DETAILS**
📍 Location: Central Burnaby, BC
📅 Shoot date: October 29, 2026
💰 Compensation: Volunteer, with demo reel material, photos, IMDb credit, and food provided on set
🎭 Open to UBCP/ACTRA members and non-union performers
📩 Submission deadline: October 20, 2026

**HOW TO APPLY**
Please email your headshot, demo reel (if available), and resume to **amistakeshortfilm@gmail.com**. We are also open to first time actors and those who have had no formal training. 

Use the subject line: **[Your Name] – [Character Name] Audition**

Shortlisted applicants will receive **self-tape instructions**. Feel free to share with anyone who might be a good fit. Thanks!

items.text:
Hi! I thought I’d share a little tool I built for myself in case it might be useful to others here.

My daughter does auditions, and I found it surprisingly hard to keep track of everything — submissions, audition requests, callbacks, holds, and shoot dates. Things get scattered across emails and messages, and I wanted one place where I could see everything and keep a history of how things were going.

So I built [CastTrack](https://casttrack.vercel.app/).

It’s a simple casting tracker for parents of young performers. I use it to keep track of where my daughter is with each project and to look back at her audition history and stats.

It’s completely free. I’m a web developer, so it was also a fun project to build for my portfolio, and honestly, I just didn’t want to pay for a tool I needed myself. I’m not planning to monetize it.

My daughter currently auditions mostly through Casting Networks, so that’s what I’ve used it with the most, but it should work with other platforms too.

It’s very much a tool I made to solve my own problem, but maybe someone else will find it useful too. If you try it, I’d love to hear what you think or what could be improved!

[https://casttrack.vercel.app/](https://casttrack.vercel.app/)

🎥POSZUKUJĘ GRUPY TANECZNEJ DO TELEDYSKU DISCO! 💃🕺🎶🎥
Cześć! 👋 Szukam 3–4 osób lub większej grupy tanecznej chętnych do wystąpienia w moim nowym teledysku disco polo! 🎤🔥

📍 Miejsce nagrania: Białystok

Najlepiej, jeśli zgłoszą się osoby z Białegostoku lub okolic.

📅 Termin: piątek(wiem,że późno😉)

🎬 Co trzeba zrobić? Zatańczyć do jednej lub dwóch piosenek. Chodzi o krótkie ujęcia taneczne, które zostaną wykorzystane jako przebitki w teledysku.

🎭 Pomysł na występ: planuję taniec w maskach, żeby stworzyć większe show i nadać klipowi wyjątkowy klimat! 😎 Dzięki temu wizerunek uczestników nie musi być pokazywany. Jeśli ktoś będzie chciał wystąpić bez maski i zgodzi się na wykorzystanie swojego wizerunku, również możemy to ustalić.

💰 Występ płatny – wynagrodzenie do uzgodnienia!

📩 Osoby zainteresowane zapraszam do wiadomości prywatnej. Ustalimy szczegóły, miejsce, godziny oraz wynagrodzenie.

am Dienstag, 03.11.2026 – 7:15 Uhr, Hotel Zeitgeist Vienna  

Vortrag: Mag. Thomas Dürrer (Geschäftsführer LSG)  
Rechte, Reichweite, Rückvergütung – die LSG  
Moderation:  Monika Medek 

Was passiert eigentlich mit den Entgelten für die Nutzung von Musik auf Radio, TV, im Web oder in Bibliotheken? Die LSG – Wahrnehmung von Leistungsschutzrechten GmbH – sorgt dafür, dass Interpret*innen und Labels ihren Anteil aus den sogenannten Leistungsschutzrechten erhalten. Thomas Dürrer erklärt bei diesem Impuls, welche Rechte Künstler*innen übertragen können und wie die Verteilung funktioniert.  
©Mag. Thomas Dürrer  

Adresse: Sonnwendgasse 15, 1100 Wien

Der Kino Mittwoch auf radioYpsilon, dein Lieblingssender 

MOVIETIME KW 42/2026

HASTA LA VISTA BABY, 2 Ö FILM DOKUS INKL INTERVIEWS UND KINDERBUCHVERFILMUNGEN

Zwei interessante wie auch unterschiedliche Film Dokus made in Austria starten mit ATMOSPHERE und WELLEN WENDE aktuell im Kino. Mit den Machern dieser Filme, Erwin Wagenhofer und Josephine Ahnelt konnte Sarah Fuchs jeweils ein Gespräch führen.

Zwei Kinderbuchromane lassen die Herzen der Jüngsten mit BIBI BLOCKSBERG - TOTAL VERHEXT und einem weiteren Remake von EMIL UND DIE DETEKTIVE höher schlagen. 

Vor 35 Jahren schlüpfte Arnold Schwarzenegger mit TERMINATOR 2 erneut in die Rolle des Cyborgs und revolutionierte gemeinsam mit Regisseur James Cameron das Action Kino.

Musikalisch untermalt wird diese Sendung mit den bekanntesten Songs aus dem Kino der letzten 80 Jahre.

Mittwoch 14.10.2026 von 18 bis 19h auf radioYpsilon 94.5 oder via Stream (http://mp3.radioypsilon.at:8000/)

**SEEKING A BOYS’ CHOIR — SHORT FILM COLLABORATION**

**London | Recording and optional filming**

We’re looking for an **established boys’ choir**, with singers aged **7–12**, based in or around **London**, to collaborate on *Castrato*, a short psychological horror film set in the 1970s.

The story follows a young orphan whose extraordinary singing voice brings him into the care of a celebrated choir director. What initially feels like belonging becomes a disturbing betrayal of trust. The short introduces the world and characters of *Castrato*, with the aim of developing their story into a feature film.

Choral music is central to the story, and the participating choir would make a significant contribution to the film.

**RECORDING**
The choir would record **one song** at **Shoreditch Recording Works**, provisionally in **late November or early December**. The piece, exact date and session timings are still being finalised.

The session would give the choristers an opportunity to experience recording music for film in a professional studio. We would also provide the choir with copies of their studio recordings.

**OPTIONAL ON-SCREEN PARTICIPATION**
We would also welcome a **number of choristers** to appear as the film’s conservatoire choir. Filming is expected to take place in and around London across a few weekends in **January**, with exact dates TBC.

Appearing on screen is optional—the choir can participate in the recording alone. 

**TO EXPRESS INTEREST**
Choir leaders or representatives should email:
* The choir’s name and location
* The singers’ age range and approximate number
* General availability during the proposed recording period

**Email:** [castratofilm@gmail.com](mailto:castratofilm@gmail.com)
**Subject:** CHOIR CASTING — [CHOIR NAME]

We would be happy to arrange a call to discuss the project further.

Please feel free to share with any choirs or choir leaders who may be interested!

**CASTING CALL — TWO ADULT LEAD ROLES**

**Paid roles | London | January filming**

We’re casting **Father John and Michel-César** for *Castrato*, a short psychological horror film set in the 1970s.

The story follows a young orphan whose extraordinary singing voice brings him into the care of a celebrated choir director. What initially feels like belonging becomes a disturbing betrayal of trust. The short introduces the world and characters of *Castrato*, with the aim of developing their story into a feature film.

**FATHER JOHN — Male, playing age 50s**
A strangely attractive priest who runs the boys’ orphanage. Charming yet immediately unsettling, Father John has peculiar habits, nervous twitches and a menacing presence even when smiling. We’re looking for an actor who can embrace his strangeness without becoming cartoonish, creating discomfort through small gestures and changes in expression.

**MICHEL-CÉSAR — Male, playing age 60s**
A prestigious French choir director with a warm, almost grandfatherly presence. Meticulous about order and devoted to his choir, Michel initially feels kind and trustworthy. Gradually, subtle shifts reveal something darker beneath that warmth. We need an actor whose performance allows the unease to creep up on the audience rather than being obvious from the start.

Applicants should be based in or around **London**. Filming is expected to take place across a few weekends in **January**, with exact dates TBC. Both roles are **paid**, with rates TBC.

**TO APPLY**
Actors or agents should email:
* A headshot
* Age and location
* A CV and/or showreel link

**Email:** [castratofilm@gmail.com](mailto:castratofilm@gmail.com)
**Subject:** CASTRATO CASTING — [ROLE]

Selected applicants will receive audition material and self-tape instructions.

**Content note:** The film contains sensitive themes and violence, with no nudity or explicit surgical content. Please get in touch with any questions about the material.

Please feel free to share with anyone who may be suitable!

**CASTING CALL — TWO CHILD LEAD ROLES**

**Paid roles | London | January filming**

We’re casting **Peter and Albert** for *Castrato*, a short psychological horror film set in the 1970s.

The story follows a young orphan whose extraordinary singing voice brings him into the care of a celebrated choir director. What initially feels like belonging becomes a disturbing betrayal of trust. The short introduces the world and characters of *Castrato*, with the aim of developing their story into a feature film.

**PETER — Male, playing age 7–11**
An incredibly sweet, innocent and shy boy with an almost angelic appearance and expressive eyes. Timid and withdrawn following the loss of his parents, Peter has little dialogue. We’re looking for a young performer who can convey vulnerability through subtle expressions and reactions. Previous acting experience and confidence taking direction would be helpful.

**ALBERT — Male, playing age 10–11**
Boisterous, cocky and outwardly confident, Albert enjoys intimidating the other boys and feels threatened when Peter becomes the favourite. Beneath his bravado is a deeply insecure child. We need a performer who can move from arrogance and jealousy to the frightened, vulnerable boy underneath.

**Singing ability is required for both roles.**

Applicants should be based in or around **London**. Filming is expected to take place across a few weekends in **January**, with exact dates TBC. Both roles are **paid**, with rates TBC.

**TO APPLY**
Parents, guardians or agents should email:
* A headshot
* The actor’s age and location
* Details of acting and singing experience

**Email:** [castratofilm@gmail.com](mailto:castratofilm@gmail.com)
**Subject:** CASTRATO CASTING — [ROLE]

Selected applicants will receive audition material and self-tape instructions.

**Content note:** The film contains sensitive themes and violence, with no nudity or explicit surgical content. Please get in touch with any questions about the material.

Please feel free to share with anyone who may be suitable!

**CASTING CALL:** 3 look alikes for an ID True Crime Docu-Series 

Non-Union

Rate: $250/day

Location: Los Angeles, CA

Date: 10/27-10/28 (talent will work 1 day in this range)

This will be a recreation shoot with no dialogue. Actors will be required to sign an NDA prior to arriving on set.

***To Submit:***

***Email headshot and resume to kwall@altrealitytv.com***

Please do not DM. TIA!

Roles:

[JONATHAN]

Casting look alike for an early-mid 50's caucasian male:

Short, clean-cut gray/silver hair Clean-shaven

5'11-6'3

Slender/Lean/Slim-Athletic Build 

[DETECTIVE BLOOM]

Casting Look alike for a 40yo caucasian male:

Short, crew cut-style blonde/gray/light brown hair

Clean-shaven

5'8-6'1

Medium Build- can be athletic or stocky

Please note if you have a police-style uniform.

[LENA]

Casting Look alike for an early 30s female, ethnically ambiguous with fair, light, or olive skin (need to match a real person)

Dark, straight, shiny hair shoulder length or a few inches longer

5'7-6'0

Slim build

No visible tattoos or piercings that cannot be covered. Ear piercings are okay.

**STATISTER SØGES TIL AFGANGSFILM – DEN DANSKE FILMSKOLE**

Til afgangsfilmen *ANGELS*, instrueret af Jonatan Egholm Keis og produceret af Astrid Andreasen, søger vi statister af alle typer, køn og aldre til at agere familiemedlemmer/venner til et sølvbryllup.

**Dato:** Torsdag d. 15. oktober

**Tidsrum:** ca. 09.00-19.00

**Sted:** Storkøbenhavn

Lyder det som dig - eller kender du nogen? Så hører vi meget gerne fra dig!

Send en mail til statisten.nu@gmail.com med navn, alder, kontaktoplysninger og et vellignende billede.

Hvis du er under 18 år bedes du desuden angive navn og kontaktoplysninger på en forælder/værge.

Skriv: FESTGÆST i emnefeltet.

*OBS: Kun henvendelser via mail vil blive besvaret.*

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

***Om filmen***

*ANGELS er en rockerfilm uden læderveste, motorcykler, narko og pistoler. Det er en moderne gangsterfilm til den tid, vi lever i, som fokuserer på mennesket bag den kriminelle etikette.*

Deltagelse er ulønnet, men der vil være forplejning på set.

Do pierwszego odcinka 2. sezonu serialu „Gliniarze Śląsk” realizowanego na śląsku poszukuję kobiet do nastepujących ról:

1.Roksana (19) – młoda, ładna, pracuje w kawiarni jako barmanka/baristka. Dziewczyna z problemami psychicznymi.
Data: 26 i 27.10
Stawka: 1600 zł netto

2.Joanna (37) – przeciętna kobieta z przemocowej rodziny, zaniedbana, wystraszona   
Data: 27.10
Stawka: 800 zł netto

3. Śledcza (37) – zadbana śledcza, konkretna, rzeczowa.
Data: 30.10
Stawka: 500 zł netto

4.Iwona (41) – kobieta po stracie dziecka, załamana, rozbita, wrak człowieka. Chorobliwie szczupła i zniszczona problemami.  
Data: 30.10
Stawka: 700 zł netto

Chętne Panie zapraszam do wysyłania zgłoszeń na adres: Rita.mascarat@wp.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila prosze o podanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Miejscowość zamieszkania 

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

By Jones Hope Wooten

Directed by Ben Green 

Auditions: Monday & Tuesday, October 26 & 27 @ 7:00pm

Callbacks by invitation Wednesday, October 28th @ 7:00pm

Please bring a headshot and resume and be prepared to read from the script

Please be prepared to list any and all conflicts

A hilarious, heartfelt comedy about friendship, second chances, and starting over. Four very different Southern women find themselves at a crossroads in life. After an unexpected meeting at a yoga class, they come together for an impromptu happy hour that blossoms into a weekly gathering filled with laughter, cocktails, romantic misadventures, and life-changing revelations. As they navigate personal setbacks and unexpected new beginnings, these women discover that it’s never too late to reinvent yourself—or find your people.

We are seeking four dynamic performers with strong comedic instincts, excellent timing, and the ability to balance broad comedy with genuine emotional depth. Distinct Southern character voices are required.

Performances: January 8 through 31, 2027

Thurs–Sat at 7:30pm

Sundays at 2:00pm

Saturday matinees January 16th and 30th at 2:00pm

Rehearsals at Cabrillo Playhouse in San Clemente, CA

We welcome and encourage performers of ALL races, ages, gender identities, abilities, body types and ethnicities to audition.

There is a $100 stipend offered

We are currently looking for up to four actors to participate in our upcoming twilight spooky rides.
Here are the details for the position:

  - Dates: October 22, 23, 24, 29, 30, and 31

  - Hours: 4:00 PM – 6:00 PM (2 hours per day)

  - Pay: $50 per day (paid in cash)

  - Location: Silver Lake Railriders, 1381 Village Road, Silver Lake, NH 03875 (behind the Silver Lake Railroad Station)

Schedule & Responsibilities:

  - Station Actor (1): Remains at the station area and yard to haunt the arriving guests.

  - Trail Actors (3): At 4:00 PM, a rail motorcar will drop three actors off at designated acting locations along the route.

  - The Performance: The twilight railbike ride departs at 4:30 PM. Actors will scare guests on their way out and back. The rail motorcar will pick up the trail actors at the end of the run, returning everyone to the station around 6:00 PM for a final scare.

Requirements:

  - Safety rules must be strictly followed: no touching riders and maintain a safe distance from all equipment.

  - All actors (or parents/guardians for minors) must sign a standard liability release prior to participating.

I have created a spreadsheet to help organize and schedule interested actors. You can learn more about us at slrailriders.com.

Best regards,

Hank Walther

items.text:
**SEEKING A BOYS’ CHOIR — SHORT FILM COLLABORATION**

**London | Recording and optional filming**

We’re looking for an **established boys’ choir**, with singers aged **7–12**, based in or around **London**, to collaborate on *Castrato*, a short psychological horror film set in the 1970s.

The story follows a young orphan whose extraordinary singing voice brings him into the care of a celebrated choir director. What initially feels like belonging becomes a disturbing betrayal of trust. The short introduces the world and characters of *Castrato*, with the aim of developing their story into a feature film.

Choral music is central to the story, and the participating choir would make a significant contribution to the film.

**RECORDING**
The choir would record **one song** at **Shoreditch Recording Works**, provisionally in **late November or early December**. The piece, exact date and session timings are still being finalised.

The session would give the choristers an opportunity to experience recording music for film in a professional studio. We would also provide the choir with copies of their studio recordings.

**OPTIONAL ON-SCREEN PARTICIPATION**
We would also welcome a **number of choristers** to appear as the film’s conservatoire choir. Filming is expected to take place in and around London across a few weekends in **January**, with exact dates TBC.

Appearing on screen is optional—the choir can participate in the recording alone. 

**TO EXPRESS INTEREST**
Choir leaders or representatives should email:
* The choir’s name and location
* The singers’ age range and approximate number
* General availability during the proposed recording period

**Email:** [castratofilm@gmail.com](mailto:castratofilm@gmail.com)
**Subject:** CHOIR CASTING — [CHOIR NAME]

We would be happy to arrange a call to discuss the project further.

Please feel free to share with any choirs or choir leaders who may be interested!

items.text:
**CASTING CALL — TWO CHILD LEAD ROLES**

**Paid roles | London | January filming**

We’re casting **Peter and Albert** for *Castrato*, a short psychological horror film set in the 1970s.

The story follows a young orphan whose extraordinary singing voice brings him into the care of a celebrated choir director. What initially feels like belonging becomes a disturbing betrayal of trust. The short introduces the world and characters of *Castrato*, with the aim of developing their story into a feature film.

**PETER — Male, playing age 7–11**
An incredibly sweet, innocent and shy boy with an almost angelic appearance and expressive eyes. Timid and withdrawn following the loss of his parents, Peter has little dialogue. We’re looking for a young performer who can convey vulnerability through subtle expressions and reactions. Previous acting experience and confidence taking direction would be helpful.

**ALBERT — Male, playing age 10–11**
Boisterous, cocky and outwardly confident, Albert enjoys intimidating the other boys and feels threatened when Peter becomes the favourite. Beneath his bravado is a deeply insecure child. We need a performer who can move from arrogance and jealousy to the frightened, vulnerable boy underneath.

**Singing ability is required for both roles.**

Applicants should be based in or around **London**. Filming is expected to take place across a few weekends in **January**, with exact dates TBC. Both roles are **paid**, with rates TBC.

**TO APPLY**
Parents, guardians or agents should email:
* A headshot
* The actor’s age and location
* Details of acting and singing experience

**Email:** [castratofilm@gmail.com](mailto:castratofilm@gmail.com)
**Subject:** CASTRATO CASTING — [ROLE]

Selected applicants will receive audition material and self-tape instructions.

**Content note:** The film contains sensitive themes and violence, with no nudity or explicit surgical content. Please get in touch with any questions about the material.

Please feel free to share with anyone who may be suitable!

📅 Kiedy: Sobota, 17 października 2026 r. o godz. 17:00 📍 

Gdzie: Gdańsk (szczegóły podamy w wiadomości prywatnej)

Będzie to wywiad wyłącznie głosowy (bez nagrywania twarzy przed kamerą!).

Na czym polega zadanie? To bardzo krótka, kameralna i bezstresowa rozmowa mikrofonowa. Zadamy trzy krótkie pytania:

„Czego szukamy w galerii handlowej? Po co tu przychodzimy?” (odpowiedź na 1–2 zdania).

„Czego nam brakuje w tej obfitości?” (odpowiedź na 1 zdanie).

„Gdy myśli Pan/Pani o swojej pracy w tym całym technologicznym pędzie, to jakie jedno słowo przychodzi jako pierwsze?” (tylko jedno słowo, np. szybciej, targety, zmęczenie, powiadomienia).

🎁 Co oferujemy w zamian? 

Imię i nazwisko w napisach końcowych filmu. 

Krótką, bezpłatną profesjonalną sesję zdjęciową w ramach podziękowania.

Zainteresowane osoby proszę o kontakt przez e-mail:

1. Poproszę o wysłanie:

Imię i nazwisko, wiek, zdjęcie twarzy.

🇵🇱 CZEŚĆ WSZYSTKIM! ✨

Mam na imię Wiktoria, mam 22 lata i pochodzę ze Szczecina w Polsce. 🌸

Modeling to moja ogromna pasja, którą z każdym kolejnym doświadczeniem rozwijam coraz bardziej. Chciałabym się tutaj przedstawić, opowiedzieć trochę o swojej dotychczasowej drodze oraz nawiązać nowe znajomości i współprace w branży modowej i fotograficznej. 📸

👠 Moja przygoda z modelingiem nabiera coraz większego tempa!

Jednym z moich wyjątkowych doświadczeń był udział w castingu do 15. edycji programu Top Model, gdzie miałam okazję pojawić się w dwóch odcinkach. Choć nie udało mi się przejść do kolejnego etapu, było to dla mnie niesamowite przeżycie, które dało mi jeszcze większą motywację do działania.

Moje dotychczasowe doświadczenie:

📸 Sesje zdjęciowe – kreatywne sesje fashion, sesje studyjne oraz profesjonalne realizacje dla projektantów mody, podczas których prezentowałam ich autorskie kreacje.

👗 Pokazy mody – udział w wydarzeniach modowych, współpraca z projektantami oraz prezentowanie kolekcji na wybiegu.

👠 Warsztaty i szkolenia modelingowe – regularnie rozwijam swoje umiejętności w zakresie catwalku, pozowania, pracy przed obiektywem oraz odpowiedniej postawy i prezentacji sylwetki.

✨ Agencja modelingowa – obecnie należę do Agencji Mody Prestige. Nasza współpraca nie jest jednak oparta na umowie na wyłączność, dzięki czemu mogę również samodzielnie podejmować nowe projekty i współprace z fotografami, projektantami oraz markami.

🇦🇪 A przede mną kolejne ogromne wyzwanie – Fashion Week w Dubaju!

Już w listopadzie wybieram się do Dubaju, gdzie będę miała okazję zaprezentować kreacje projektantki na wybiegu. To dla mnie niezwykle ważny krok i możliwość zdobycia kolejnych doświadczeń na międzynarodowej scenie modowej.

W najbliższym czasie czekają mnie również kolejne pokazy mody, sesje zdjęciowe oraz nowe projekty.

Modeling to dla mnie coś więcej niż piękne zdjęcia i chodzenie po wybiegu. To przede wszystkim ciężka praca, nieustanna nauka, poznawanie inspirujących ludzi, podróże i przekraczanie własnych granic.

Wiem, że przede mną jeszcze wiele nauki i wyzwań, ale jestem ogromnie zmotywowana, aby rozwijać się w tej branży i zdobywać coraz większe doświadczenie. ❤️

🌍 Jestem otwarta na nowe współprace w Polsce i za granicą!

Chętnie podejmę współpracę z fotografami, projektantami mody, stylistami, makijażystami oraz markami. Interesują mnie sesje fashion, beauty, editorial, kampanie reklamowe, pokazy mody oraz kreatywne projekty fotograficzne.

📍 Szczecin | Polska

✈️ Możliwość dojazdu do innych miast oraz wyjazdów zagranicznych.

📲 Instagram: @wiktoriachalabus

Będzie mi bardzo miło poznać osoby, które tak samo jak ja kochają świat mody, fotografii i kreatywnych projektów!

Do zobaczenia przed obiektywem i na wybiegach! 🖤✨

⸻

🇬🇧 HELLO EVERYONE! ✨

My name is Wiktoria, I’m 22 years old, and I’m from Szczecin, Poland. 🌸

Modeling is a huge passion of mine, and with every new experience, I continue to grow and develop my skills. I’d love to introduce myself, share a little about my modeling journey so far, and connect with people from the fashion and photography industry. 📸

👠 My modeling journey is becoming more exciting with every new opportunity!

One of my most memorable experiences was participating in the casting for Season 15 of Poland’s Next Top Model (Top Model Poland), where I had the opportunity to appear in two episodes. Although I didn’t make it to the next stage, it was an incredible experience that motivated me even more to pursue my dreams.

My modeling experience so far includes:

📸 Photoshoots – creative fashion shoots, studio photography, and professional projects for fashion designers, showcasing their original creations.

👗 Fashion shows – participating in fashion events, collaborating with designers, and presenting their collections on the runway.

👠 Modeling workshops and training – continuously improving my runway walk, posing techniques, camera presence, posture, and overall presentation.

✨ Modeling agency – I am currently represented by Prestige Modeling Agency (Agencja Mody Prestige). However, my agreement is non-exclusive, which means I am also available for independent collaborations with photographers, designers, and brands.

🇦🇪 And my next big adventure is just around the corner – Dubai Fashion Week!

This November, I will be traveling to Dubai, where I will have the opportunity to walk the runway and present a fashion designer’s creations. This is an important step in my journey and an exciting opportunity to gain international modeling experience.

I also have more fashion shows, photoshoots, and creative projects coming up in the near future.

For me, modeling is much more than beautiful photographs and walking the runway. It’s about dedication, continuous learning, meeting inspiring people, traveling, and pushing myself beyond my comfort zone.

I know there is still so much for me to learn and achieve, but I am incredibly motivated to keep growing, improving my skills, and gaining valuable experience in the fashion industry. ❤️

🌍 I am open to new collaborations in Poland and internationally!

I would love to connect with photographers, fashion designers, stylists, makeup artists, and brands. I’m interested in fashion, beauty, and editorial photoshoots, advertising campaigns, runway shows, and creative photography projects.

📍 Szczecin | Poland

✈️ Available to travel to other cities and internationally.

📲 Instagram: @wiktoriachalabus

I would be delighted to connect with people who share my passion for fashion, photography, and creativity!

See you in front of the camera and on the runway! 🖤✨

items.text:
🎬 **KRAKÓW | 14–15.11.2026 | AKTORZY DO FILMU KONKURSOWEGO 48HFP** 🎬

Bierzemy udział w międzynarodowej edycji 48HFP, **Yes We Cannes,** i szukamy osób, które chcą dołączyć do naszej ekipy i wystąpić w filmie konkursowym! 🎥

  

🏆 **Dlaczego warto?** Wygraliśmy poprzednią edycję 48HFP, a teraz idziemy za ciosem i walczymy o pokaz na festiwalu w Cannes! 🇫🇷✨

📍 **Miejsce:** Kraków

📅 **Termin:** 14–15 listopada 2026

🎬 **Zdjęcia:** Główne nagrania w sobotę (14.11), ewentualne dogrywki w niedzielę (15.11).

⚠️ **Jak to działa?**

Scenariusz powstaje dopiero w noc poprzedzającą realizację, więc dokładne godziny i lokalizacje zdjęć poznamy tak naprawdę dopiero nad ranem. Szukamy osób, które lubią spontaniczne akcje i są gotowe na elastyczność oraz odrobinę filmowego szaleństwa.

Zgodnie z oficjalnymi zasadami konkursu 48HFP udział wszystkich twórców i aktorów jest nieodpłatny, cały film finansujemy z własnej kieszeni i składamy się na jego realizację, by powalczyć o wygraną.

Na planie zapewniamy pełne wyżywienie oraz świetną, profesjonalną atmosferę!

👥 **Kogo obecnie poszukujemy?**

Mamy już w obsadzie dwie aktorki, dlatego w tej chwili priorytetowo szukamy:
* **Mężczyzn (wiek ok. 25–30 lat)**
* **Osoby w wieku 30+**

*(Niezależnie od powyższego, chętnie przyjmiemy i przejrzymy wszystkie zgłoszenia!)*

Chcesz przeżyć intensywną filmową przygodę i powalczyć z nami o Cannes? **Napisz do nas w wiadomości prywatnej!** Podeślij swoje portfolio oraz kilka słów o sobie.

Dla uwagi załączam plakat z naszego zwycięskiego filmu z poprzedniej edycji! 🖼️👇

Będziemy ogromnie wdzięczni za udostępnienia i polecenia! 🙌

Scenariusz powstaje dopiero w noc poprzedzającą realizację, więc dokładne godziny i lokalizacje zdjęć poznamy tak naprawdę dopiero nad ranem. Szukamy osób, które lubią spontaniczne akcje i są gotowe na elastyczność oraz odrobinę filmowego szaleństwa.

Zgodnie z oficjalnymi zasadami konkursu 48HFP udział wszystkich twórców i aktorów jest nieodpłatny, cały film finansujemy z własnej kieszeni i składamy się na jego realizację, by powalczyć o wygraną.

Na planie zapewniamy pełne wyżywienie oraz świetną, profesjonalną atmosferę!

👥 **Kogo obecnie poszukujemy?**

Mamy już w obsadzie dwie aktorki, dlatego w tej chwili priorytetowo szukamy:
* **Mężczyzn (wiek ok. 25–30 lat)**
* **Osoby w wieku 30+**

*(Niezależnie od powyższego, chętnie przyjmiemy i przejrzymy wszystkie zgłoszenia!)*

Chcesz przeżyć intensywną filmową przygodę i powalczyć z nami o Cannes? **Napisz do nas w wiadomości prywatnej!** Podeślij swoje portfolio oraz kilka słów o sobie.

Dla uwagi załączam plakat z naszego zwycięskiego filmu z poprzedniej edycji! 🖼️👇

Będziemy ogromnie wdzięczni za udostępnienia i polecenia! 🙌

Are you a Descendant of the  Mayflower passengers?

Jodi Purdy Casting Director sharing:

Casting Call 

Archive House Productions is filming a docuseries exploring the legacy of the pilgrims' and their role in shaping America's cultural heritage. 

We're looking for descendants of passengers who sailed on the Mayflower to join us for a filmed dinner the week before or after Thanksgiving in one of three locations: Providence, RI; Boston, MA; and Albany, NY. 

You will receive a stipend for your time. 

Please register your interest by filling in this form. If you are casted, the production will be in touch. 

Please share that you heard of this from Jodi Purdy!

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSedRqN8a14kY5jmvJrknJXM_9JsF8BG7oojWz8BB1L3YUhJEg/viewform?
